title: Happynood/llm-inference-benchmark
summary: Happynood/llm-inference-benchmark是一个可重复的LLM推理优化实验室，用于比较不同后端、量化、延迟、VRAM和输出正确性。该项目使用Python编写，专注于模型推理性能的基准测试，适用于本地硬件。
description: Reproducible LLM inference optimization lab for comparing backends, quantization, latency, VRAM, and output sanity on local hardware.
